_note: Zone site catalogue, keyed by zone id (Design's data/zones.json holds each zone's numbers). Zone 7 site catalogue (World & Level). Positions use the raid.json convention: radius = fraction of playableRadius, bearing in degrees (0 = north = -Z, 90 = east = +X). Every site here is pre-shaped in the terrain; each raid draws which ones are live from its seed (src/world/layout.ts). Counts and open times come from RAID.larva; this file only says where things can be.

geneBlooms._note: Harvest nodes: clusters of DNA-heavy bulbs, opened like a container (loot.json geneBloom). Riskier sites carry the same table; the risk is where they grow.

anomaly._note: One anomaly per Larva raid. gravityMultiplier comes from RAID.host.anomalies (gravityBloom); size is the Larva-scale radius in metres.

structures._note: Enterable structures (src/world/structures.ts). hollowSpire: chitin hive tower, three floors, open top. reliquaryBowl: the zone boss arena (Design: THE RELIQUARY), a sunken bowl with two entrances, a 3 m ledge round the north half, four breakable pillars and a liquid-light pool. yaw in degrees turns the structure about its centre. longSeedDebris: torn hull sections of the crashed seedship, cargo crates and the black box.

landmarks._note: Named places for contracts (Design's zones.json landmark ids). `site` names a catalogue site; radius in metres counts as being there. fungalCaves is not built yet.

longSeedWreck._note: Zone 2 (the Wreck of the Long Seed as its own map). Geometry comes with its build PR.
